arguments.command:
cat <<'EOF' > filter_spaces.rb
require 'openstudio'

# Load model
model = OpenStudio::Model::Model.new
if ARGV.size < 2
  puts "Usage: openstudio execute_ruby_script filter_spaces.rb input.osm output.osm"
  exit 1
end
input_path = ARGV[0]
output_path = ARGV[1]

if !File.exist?(input_path)
  puts "Input file not found: #{input_path}"
  exit 1
end

model = OpenStudio::Model::Model.load(input_path).get

# Keep spaces with names containing Gym, Auditorium, or Gym Audience
keep_names = ['Gym', 'Auditorium', 'Gym Audience']

# Collect spaces to keep
spaces_to_keep = model.getSpaces.select do |space|
  name = space.name.to_s
  keep_names.any? { |kw| name.include?(kw) }
end

# Delete all other spaces
model.getSpaces.each do |space|
  next if spaces_to_keep.include?(space)
  space.remove
end

# Save model
if model.save(output_path, true)
  puts "Saved reduced model to #{output_path}"
else
  puts "Failed to save model"
  exit 1
end
EOF
